description.value: Alter Ego Bikes is one of Canada's original e-bike dealers, established in 2014 and operating a physical factory outlet showroom in Chilliwack, BC. The shop carries a curated roster of major e-bike brands — Aventon, Velotric, Himiway, and others — and runs a dedicated service department that handles diagnostics, repairs, and tuneups for everything they sell. Touring cyclists riding e-bikes will find a knowledgeable staff and full servicing capability under one roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich. A critical discrepancy exists: OSM lists '34150 South Fraser Way, unit 1a, V2S 2C6' but the website's Location & Hours section clearly shows '44335 Yale Road, Unit B1, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4H2', indicating a likely relocation — the website address is treated as current per Rule 12. The service department page ('WE FIX EVERYTHING WE SELL!') confirms full e-bike servicing with appointments; a pump and walk-in policy are not explicitly mentioned. Phone numbers (778.360.2122 / 888.561.5330) appear only on the website, not in the OSM record.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM shows '34150 South Fraser Way, unit 1a, V2S 2C6' but the business website clearly lists '44335 Yale Road, Unit B1, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4H2' — the business appears to have relocated and the OSM record needs updating.
No phone number in OSM record; website lists two numbers (778.360.2122 and 888.561.5330).

Service appointments are encouraged and some service categories are restricted (no Amazon/Costco purchases, no e-scooters, e-dirt bikes, or tricycles) — walk-in repair availability for passing touring cyclists is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active e-bike specialty shop with a full service department in Chilliwack — directly relevant to touring cyclists riding e-bikes who need servicing, diagnostics, or parts in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Test rides and demos are available per the About Us page ('Test Rides & Demos: See the difference for yourself'). The shop explicitly does not service e-bikes purchased from Amazon, Costco, or big-box stores, which may be relevant for some touring cyclists.
